title: VRPO: Rethinking Value Modeling for Robust RL under Noisy Supervision in LLM Post-Training
authors_zh: Dingwei Zhu 等（复旦大学、荣耀终端有限公司等）
paper_type_zh: 稳健强化学习目标与价值建模研究
best_for_zh: 适合用带噪规则奖励或学习奖励训练大模型，并需诊断奖励黑客与优势估计不稳定问题的读者。
one_line: VRPO makes the value model a noise-regulating part of RL training so uncertain rewards produce more reliable advantage signals.
VRPO 把价值模型变为强化学习中的噪声调节器，使不确定奖励产生更可靠的优势信号。
why: It treats value estimation as the place where noisy training feedback can be filtered before it becomes a policy update.
inclusion_reason: It changes how noisy reward records are converted into value targets and advantages for RL, directly altering the training objective's consumption of supervision.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reward supervision in post-training RL can be sparse, ambiguous, or wrong. When a noisy reward enters generalized advantage estimation, the error is not confined to one scalar: it propagates into value predictions and token-level advantages, causing unstable updates, length hacking, or a collapse in policy quality. Reward denoising and sample filtering address part of this problem but leave the value model as a passive recipient of the same unstable signal.

VRPO asks whether the value model itself can absorb and regulate noisy supervision before it drives a policy update. The paper changes the learning path from reward to advantage, rather than collecting a new reward dataset. Its focus is on the training objective and value target used to consume noisy rollout feedback in RL.

后训练强化学习中的奖励监督可能稀疏、模糊或错误。当带噪奖励进入广义优势估计时，误差并不局限于一个标量：它会传播到价值预测和词元级优势，导致更新不稳定、长度黑客或策略质量坍塌。奖励去噪和样本过滤能处理部分问题，却仍让价值模型被动接收同样不稳定的信号。

VRPO 询问价值模型本身能否在驱动策略更新前吸收并调节带噪监督。论文改变的是从奖励到优势的学习路径，而不是收集新的奖励数据集。它关注强化学习中用于消费带噪回放反馈的训练目标和价值目标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
VRPO treats a value model as a semantic noise regulator. A variational information bottleneck compresses the rollout representation so that the value prediction retains return-relevant information while discarding irrelevant detail. This is paired with auxiliary losses derived from a frozen language model's entropy and perplexity, directing the value model toward semantically uncertain or difficult tokens rather than merely fitting noisy returns.

The resulting value estimates enter advantage computation and therefore change what the policy is reinforced to do. The paper's key distinction is that it does not assume noisy rewards can be repaired at their source; it uses denser value supervision to compensate for their downstream effect. High-entropy and high-perplexity token selection makes this adjustment targeted rather than applying identical semantic loss to every token.

VRPO 将价值模型视为语义噪声调节器。变分信息瓶颈压缩回放表示，使价值预测保留与回报相关的信息，同时丢弃无关细节。它再与来自冻结语言模型熵和困惑度的辅助损失配合，引导价值模型关注语义上不确定或困难的词元，而不只是拟合带噪回报。

由此得到的价值估计进入优势计算，因此改变了策略被强化去做什么。论文的关键区别是，它不假定带噪奖励能在源头修复；它使用更密集的价值监督补偿奖励的下游影响。高熵和高困惑度词元选择使这种调整具有针对性，而不是对每个词元施加相同的语义损失。

title: Method
方法
html:
The information-bottleneck value model maps a rollout state to a Gaussian latent representation and predicts return from that latent. Its loss combines return prediction with a Kullback-Leibler penalty that limits information retained from the input. Separately, a frozen language-model head identifies tokens above entropy and perplexity thresholds; entropy and negative log-probability losses on those subsets regularize the value model's internal representation. The complete value loss is then used inside a PPO-style optimization loop.

The paper tests learned dialogue rewards and rule-based majority-vote rewards. In rule-based training it uses five samples for voting, with 32 used in test-time optimization; it evaluates math and science with Qwen and Llama-family variants, and dialogue under a learned reward model. Reproduction requires reward-noise construction, rollout and voting protocol, value latent architecture, token thresholds, auxiliary-loss weights, policy initialization, and evaluation judge versions, because each alters the resulting advantage targets.

信息瓶颈价值模型将回放状态映射到高斯潜在表示，再从该表示预测回报。其损失把回报预测与限制从输入保留信息量的 Kullback-Leibler 惩罚结合。与此同时，一个冻结语言模型头识别高于熵和困惑度阈值的词元；这些子集上的熵与负对数概率损失会正则化价值模型的内部表示。完整价值损失随后被放入 PPO 类优化循环。

论文测试了学习式对话奖励和基于规则的多数投票奖励。基于规则训练中它用五个样本投票，测试时优化使用 32 个；它以 Qwen 和 Llama 系列变体评测数学与科学任务，并在学习式奖励模型下评测对话。复现需要奖励噪声构造、回放与投票协议、价值潜变量架构、词元阈值、辅助损失权重、策略初始化和评判器版本，因为每一项都会改变最终优势目标。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under rule-based noisy rewards, VRPO raises the reported Qwen3-8B average accuracy across four mathematics and three science tasks from 34.64% before RL to 38.14%, exceeding Reinforce++ at 36.60% and Dr.GRPO at 36.59%. In the weaker Qwen2.5-7B cold-start setting, it reaches 25.08% average accuracy, compared with 14.41% for GRPO and 20.60% for PPO. These comparisons support the claim that value-side regularization can stabilize optimization when reward noise is consequential.

The paper also reports that entropy and perplexity regularization of the value model obtains 42.41% average accuracy on a noisy math setting versus 39.51% for value-model cross-entropy, and that activating 80% of high-uncertainty tokens is better than activating all tokens. In learned-reward dialogue, it reports task-completion improvement from 72.1% to 75.9% and final average performance of 83.80%, while PPO and GRPO exhibit instability. The evidence is diverse but not a proof that every reward error can be corrected by a value model.

在基于规则的带噪奖励下，VRPO 将报告的 Qwen3-8B 在四个数学和三个科学任务上的平均准确率从强化学习前的 34.64% 提升到 38.14%，高于 Reinforce++ 的 36.60% 和 Dr.GRPO 的 36.59%。在较弱的 Qwen2.5-7B 冷启动设置中，它达到 25.08% 平均准确率，而 GRPO 为 14.41%，PPO 为 20.60%。这些比较支持这样一个主张：当奖励噪声影响显著时，价值侧正则化能稳定优化。

论文还报告，在一个带噪数学设置中，价值模型的熵和困惑度正则化获得 42.41% 平均准确率，而价值模型交叉熵为 39.51%；激活 80% 高不确定性词元优于激活全部词元。在学习式奖励的对话中，它报告任务完成率从 72.1% 提升到 75.9%，最终平均表现为 83.80%，而 PPO 和 GRPO 出现不稳定。证据覆盖面较广，但并不证明每一种奖励错误都能由价值模型修复。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Robust RL work often modifies the reward model or filters noisy records before a policy update. VRPO instead makes the value function the explicit intervention point: a value prediction is trained to be compact and semantically aware, then supplies the advantage used by the policy objective. This changes the consumer of a noisy reward without claiming to make the original reward label clean.

The paper does not introduce a new reward dataset or a general verifier. Its reusable novelty is the combination of information-bottleneck value modeling and selective language-model-guided losses as a way to transform reward feedback into policy gradients. Before reuse, compare against direct reward denoising, inspect whether key-token selection tracks useful content rather than style, and measure whether it reduces reward hacking without suppressing legitimate long reasoning.

稳健强化学习工作常修改奖励模型，或在策略更新前过滤带噪记录。VRPO 则把价值函数作为显式干预点：价值预测被训练得紧凑且具有语义感知，然后提供策略目标使用的优势。这改变了带噪奖励的消费者，却不声称原始奖励标签因此变得干净。

论文并未提出新的奖励数据集或通用验证器。它可复用的新意是把信息瓶颈价值建模和选择性的语言模型引导损失结合，用于将奖励反馈转化为策略梯度。复用前，应与直接奖励去噪比较，检查关键词元选择是否跟踪有用内容而非文风，并测量它是否减少奖励黑客而不压制合理的长推理。

title: Limitations
局限
html: VRPO does not resolve all kinds of reward noise, and its value-side regularization adds architecture, threshold, and auxiliary-loss choices that must be tuned. The rule-based experiments are confined to mathematics and science, with single-dataset training and evaluation per model, while the dialogue data are not released as a standalone artifact. The method can also inherit bias from the frozen language model and from the reward source. A reuse should test whether its token selection suppresses important minority reasoning, how sensitive results are to the bottleneck and activation fraction, and whether gains persist under independently audited rewards.
VRPO 无法解决所有类型的奖励噪声，其价值侧正则化还增加了需要调节的架构、阈值和辅助损失选择。基于规则的实验仅限于数学和科学，每个模型只在单一数据集上训练和评测，而对话数据未作为独立工件发布。该方法还会继承冻结语言模型和奖励来源的偏差。复用时应测试词元选择是否压制重要的少数推理、结果对瓶颈与激活比例有多敏感，以及收益是否能在独立审计的奖励下持续存在。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use VRPO when RL already relies on weak verifiers, majority-vote pseudo-labels, or learned reward models and training exhibits unstable advantages or reward hacking. Log reward provenance, noise construction, value-prediction error, explained variance, selected token fraction, response length, and task result together; otherwise an apparent performance gain cannot be separated from a change in reward exploitation. It is a fit for improving the consumption of noisy supervision, not a replacement for repairing a fundamentally invalid reward specification.
当强化学习已依赖较弱验证器、多数投票伪标签或学习式奖励模型，且训练出现优势不稳定或奖励黑客时，可使用 VRPO。应一同记录奖励谱系、噪声构造、价值预测误差、解释方差、选中词元比例、回答长度和任务结果；否则无法把表面性能提升与奖励利用方式改变区分开来。它适合改善带噪监督的消费方式，而不是替代修复根本无效的奖励规范。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Remember VRPO as a claim about where to place the noise filter: not only at the reward label, but at the value prediction that converts rewards into advantages. Its most concrete evidence is the value-model ablation, the multi-domain noisy-reward comparison, and the response-length behavior under dialogue reward hacking. The key audit question is whether the richer value model captures return-relevant semantics or merely learns another proxy that will fail under a new reward distribution.
应把 VRPO 记为关于噪声过滤器应放在哪里的主张：不只放在奖励标签处，也放在把奖励转化为优势的价值预测处。它最具体的证据是价值模型消融、多领域带噪奖励比较，以及对话奖励黑客下的回答长度行为。关键审计问题是，更丰富的价值模型是否捕捉了与回报相关的语义，还是只学得了另一个会在新奖励分布下失效的代理。
